messages:
Maria (CS): Heads-up — ApexBio's onboarding pilot is spiking from APAC and Canada, customers seeing 600–1200ms tail latency and some 429s. They asked for a short-lived QPS bump + IP allowlist for their proxy. Renewal meeting next week; need this to look healthy.
Ben (Infra): Can you paste the customer IPs + how long they need the bump? Also what target QPS and which deployment regions (apac / canada-central)?
Maria (CS): IPs: 35.198.12.0/24, 34.98.55.128/25. Need burst to 300 qps steady for 2 weeks, with 1 minute autoscale bursts to 450 for demos. Start ASAP, auto-revoke after 14 days. Customer: ApexBio (pilot org id: apex-221).
Li (Eng): Model variant? Are they hitting hosted endpoints or Dedicated? If hosted, we should route APAC -> ap-southeast-1 regional edge and CA -> northamerica-nl-edge, confirm fallback to gpt-open-compact if latency > 500ms.
Maria (CS): They use our hosted API, model pinned to redwood/fast-1. Fallback agreed.
Ben (Infra): Ok — I'll stage a temporary ratewindow and IP allowlist. Creating policy now. Snippet for audit: ```
PATCH /policies/rl windows/apex-221
{ "allowlist": ["35.198.12.0/24","34.98.55.128/25"], "qps": 300, "burst_qps": 450, "expires_at": "2024-04-09T15:00:00Z" }
```
Ben (Infra): Ticket created CS-9421. Will post when applied.
deploy-bot: policy-change applied for apex-221 by ben_infra at 2024-03-26T18:20:12Z :white_check_mark:
Maria (CS): Awesome — I'll let the customer know and schedule a follow-up health check in 72h. Please add a metric dashboard link (latency/p95, 429s) to the ticket.
Ben (Infra): Added dashboard https://console.redwood/metrics/apex-221/latency and put a 72h alert: p95 > 450ms -> notify #eng-oncall and @Li (Eng).
Li (Eng): I'll watch for any KV cache thrash or cold-start impact. If we see model switchovers, I'll enable sticky routing for apex-221.
Maria (CS): Thanks all. One more — can we ensure the allowlist change is logged for compliance? We need the audit record for the renewal packet.
Ben (Infra): deploy-bot shows audit entry id audit-20240326-77. I'll attach to CS-9421. :thumbsup:
Maria (CS): Perfect. Marking as resolved on our side once 72h check passes.
thread_text_summary: Onboard request from ApexBio for temporary QPS increase and IP allowlist in APAC + Canada; infra applied policy; ticket CS-9421; deploy-bot logged audit entry; follow-up 72h health check scheduled.
